notes.title: Release Notes
notes.notes: Some levels have been optimized and [b]leaderboards[/b] have been added. When you reach the last level, an upload button will appear at the top of the interface. Clicking the button will upload your number of mistakes to the leaderboard. The fewer the number, the higher you will be. You can visit https://steamcommunity.com//stats/2979710/leaderboards/13867137 to view the leaderboard.
